scope: Disposable GitHub-hosted runner lane: the scanner scans only the runner it runs on
description: Disposable GitHub-hosted runner environment, scanned by the runner itself and destroyed after the run.
viewpoints: Network interface ('self', the runner's own primary IPv4): no application, database or monitoring port may be reachable. Loopback: exactly the localhost-only ports the lane publishes (Grafana 3000, image registry 5000, API 8089, Prometheus 9091); MySQL, the management port and the build tools must stay closed.
